description: Transform a flat CSV file (employee_access.csv) containing employee department assignments into a nested JSON structure (access_control.json). The CSV has columns: department, employee_id, employee_name, role. The required JSON format is: {"departments": {"<dept_name>": {"employees": [{"id": "<emp_id>", "name": "<emp_name>", "roles": ["<role1>", "<role2>"]}]}}}. Handle these edge cases: (1) Employees with multiple roles appear in multiple CSV rows - group their roles into a single array in JSON, (2) Department names may contain commas and are quoted in CSV, (3) Some fields have extra whitespace - trim all values. The CSV contains 15 rows. All rows must be preserved in the transformation. Save the output to /home/ga/workspace/data_migration/access_control.json. You may write a transformation script in any language (Python, Node.js, etc.) to perform this conversion. See the README.md file in the workspace for detailed requirements and expected JSON structure example.
